title: Unrouted broker position close stub (_maybe_send_close_to_broker)
description: backend/app/routers/portfolio.py:73-81 implements _maybe_send_close_to_broker as an unrouted no-op stub when sendToBroker=True. Manual closures record realized P&L and archive active positions in the database, but do not transmit order requests to Tradier, IBKR, Alpaca, or Tastytrade.
remediation: Documented operational boundary for live trade exit routing.

title: Offline basket tracker naming in SendToBrokerDialog
description: frontend/components/organisms/SendToBrokerDialog/index.tsx functions as an offline basket tracker that adds local positions with source='manual'. Real options orders are transmitted directly from step-7-trade-card/page.tsx via api.postOptionOrder, which can cause user confusion regarding order transmission from the dialog.
remediation: Clarify UI copy indicating offline basket addition vs immediate live broker transmission.

title: Live broker paper gateway verification requires authorized local desktop session
description: IBKR Client Portal gateway (port 7499) and local Tradier/Tastytrade sandbox accounts require active daemon sessions and valid API tokens on Kenneth's host machine. Verified via deterministic mock harnesses in test suites.
remediation: Live paper executions to be validated during authorized interactive sessions.
